The mirror itself is not redistributed and its own source record forbids that. Gloss wording is ai-drafted, not copied; no dictionary definition text is reproduced. This record exists so downstream users see the ShareAlike obligation on the dictionary-derived layer even though the pack-level content_license (CC-BY-4.0) covers this project's original material. license.notes: The `radicals` lists are KRADFILE visible-component lists (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0; upstream source record `kradfile`), taken from the jmdict-simplified 3.6.2 kradfile-3.6.2.json conversion, deduplicated with source order kept. KRADFILE elements are not the classical 214 radicals: the file lists every element visible in the glyph, including nested ones (口 inside 舌 for 話), and substitutes a JIS X 0208 kanji or katakana stroke name where an element has no standalone glyph (ハ ノ ｜ ヨ). So some learner-facing lists read as strokes rather than named radicals - that is a property of the source, not of the conversion. Added 2026-10-15 as the O-07 option-A resolution; the previously unattributed lists were replaced wholesale.
